title: Closed Expressions for the Weight Distributions of Codes Associated with Perfect Codes
summary: Perfect codes are arguably the most fascinating structures in combinatorial coding theory, and their classification and weight distribution are of considerable interest. This classification also involves the analysis of some related structures. This paper considers five closely related structures, but all of them have never been tied together before. These structures are 1-perfect codes, extended 1-perfect codes, nearly perfect 1-covering codes, extended nearly perfect 1-covering codes, and one family of completely regular codes (to be called diamond codes).
